en.headline: 14-year-old arrested after classmate's cat dies of suspected abuse
en.dek: Police say the boy, who had been fostering an eight-month-old cat, was detained on suspicion of animal cruelty after a Cheung Sha Wan veterinary clinic reported suspicious injuries.
body: A 14-year-old boy has been arrested on suspicion of animal cruelty after an eight-month-old cat he was fostering for a classmate died with injuries that a veterinary clinic found suspicious.

Police said they received a report at about 6.25 p.m. on 10 August from staff at a veterinary centre on Castle Peak Road in Cheung Sha Wan. The boy had brought the grey-and-white long-haired cat for treatment; the animal was found to have no heartbeat, blood around the mouth and nose, was soaked and showed signs of fluid accumulation in the abdomen.

Officers determined that the cat had been slapped and kicked at a residence in Cheung Sha Wan earlier the same day. The boy, who police said was fostering the pet because the classmate was temporarily outside Hong Kong, was arrested on suspicion of cruelty to animals under the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Ordinance. The case was handed to the Sham Shui Po District Crime Investigation Team for further inquiries. The maximum penalty on summary conviction is a HK$200,000 fine and three years' imprisonment.

zh.headline: 14歲少年涉虐死同學託管貓隻被捕
zh.dek: 長沙灣獸醫診所發現八個月大貓隻傷勢可疑後報警，警方指少年曾在家中掌摑及踢向貓隻，以涉嫌殘酷對待動物拘捕。
body: 一名14歲男學生涉嫌殘酷對待動物被捕。他代同學暫管一隻約八個月大的灰白色長毛起司貓期間，貓隻死亡，傷勢惹起獸醫診所懷疑。
警方表示，8月10日下午約6時25分接獲長沙灣青山道一間動物醫療中心職員報案，指該少年帶同貓隻求診。獸醫檢查發現貓隻已無心跳、口鼻有血、全身濕透及腹部積水。
調查顯示，同日較早前有人在長沙灣一處住所掌摑及踢向該貓。少年因同學暫時離港而代為照顧約一個月。他涉嫌違反《防止殘酷對待動物條例》被捕，案件交由深水埗警區刑事調查支援小隊跟進。循簡易程序定罪最高可判罰款20萬元及監禁三年。
